body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Garmin International today announced its first touchscreen handheld 'Approach G5' designed for the golf users at the pre-press event 'digital experience.'

Adopting a 3-inch touchscreen display, this waterproof Approach G5 offers two simple options once powered on: Play and Preview. While playing, golfers will see detailed course maps with precise distance information from their current location to fairways, hazards and greens.
